rubric.role_summary: First dedicated recruiting and people operations hire, responsible for full-cycle technical and operations recruiting and building onboarding, HR systems, benefits, and other people processes as the company scales.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
First dedicated recruiting and people operations hire, responsible for full-cycle technical and operations recruiting and building onboarding, HR systems, benefits, and other people processes as the company scales.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 3+ years of recruiting experience.
- Experience recruiting technical talent.
- Hands-on people operations experience.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- 3+ years of recruiting experience, with real ownership in a fast-growing startup or high-performance environment.
- Track record of personally recruiting and closing technical talent.
- Experience helping an organization scale from 10's of employees to 100+.
- Ability to source candidates who are not actively applying.
- Hands-on experience with HRIS, benefits, onboarding, and other core people operations.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: San Francisco Bay Area, California. Onsite work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
